GridBox / LineGridScene
|-- A scene pairs a root box with a diagram lookup.
|   |-- Diagram boxes reference content through a local content key.
|   |-- Container boxes hold children and a push-right layout gap.
|   `-- Boxes record position, optional minimum size and collapse state.
|       `-- A collapsed box requires separate summary content.
|-- Grid geometry uses zero-based cells and exclusive outer edges.
|   |-- resolveScene adds parent origins and measures referenced ASCII.
|   |-- Expanded containers encompass children and honor minimum size.
|   `-- Collapsed boxes omit children and expanded minimum size.
|-- Exported functions transform or inspect scene values.
|   |-- updateGridBox returns an edited tree without mutating the input.
|   |-- layoutScene anchors the changed subtree at each ancestor.
|   |   `-- Stable sibling ordering settles collisions by moving right.
|   |-- composeScene paints resolved content and rejects sibling overlaps.
|   |   `-- Extent and cell limits constrain canvas allocation.
|   `-- hitTest searches resolved children and returns local coordinates.
|-- MappingGridDocument adds edges, sections and optional jumps.
|   |-- insertGridDiagram creates summary content through DiagramService.
|   `-- It inserts into a container and calls layoutScene.
`-- Grid data describes placement; it does not manage diagram revisions.
    |-- Controllers publish scene changes through their edit boundary.
    `-- projectMapping requires box bounds and diagram-local mapping coordinates.
